Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a classic AP-MS (Affinity Purification Mass Spectrometry) using Flag-tagged PQLC2. Acquisition is DDA (Top 20 mode). Quantification is performed using SAINTexpress for interaction confidence, which is typical for label-free AP-MS workflows.

scope: 10 mg of lysate was combined with 40 µL of anti-Flag M2 magnetic beads (Sigma-Aldrich) slurry and rotated for 2 h at 4´C.
Bound proteins were eluted in 40 µL of a 100 µg/mL solution of 3X Flag peptide (Sigma-Aldrich) resuspended in TBS
determined the identity of its binding partners by co-immunoprecipitation followed by mass spectrometric analysis.

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The mass spectrometry analysis was performed on material affinity-purified using anti-Flag M2 magnetic beads to capture PQLC2-Flag and its interacting partners.
